verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll, HR and compliance platform that could plausibly offer automation workflows, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back user automations. Its date-based API versioning covers the partner API contract, not a user's own automations, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
